name: Defender Handoff Release Gate Recovery
changes: Carries the reviewed v3.6.92 Defender handoff architecture forward unchanged: verified Setup launches directly and NewzDeckPicker.exe remains folder-picker-only.
Repairs the canonical installed-upgrade smoke test so it no longer invokes the intentionally removed NewzDeckPicker.exe --taskbar-fix mode.
Uses a purpose-built inert legacy Picker-lock stand-in during CI to prove Setup can terminate and replace an in-use NewzDeckPicker.exe without restoring retired production behavior.
Preserves SABnzbd 5.1.2, Metadata Server v0.3.3, Diagnostic Collector v1.0.31, Automation/Wanted/Smart Import, Newsgroup Browser behavior, and the Defender-accepted yEnc pipeline.
regression_guards: NewzDeckPicker.go remains folder-picker-only and may not regain --update-handoff, --close-app-windows, --taskbar-fix, process launching, browser-window control, or elevation behavior.
server.py retains the direct checksum-verified Setup update path and may not recreate NewzDeckUpdateHandoff temporary executables.
NewzDeck.iss continues to use NewzDeck.exe --close-app-windows after overlay and may not execute Picker during upgrade.
The canonical runtime smoke test must simulate a legacy locked Picker with an inert stand-in executable rather than invoking a retired Picker mode.
The Picker retains normal Go build metadata (-H windowsgui), and the pinned Defender-accepted yEnc LF/Linux binary remains unchanged.
